memory_update.text: AMZN, WMT, CART, TGT, and DASH are the highest-priority direct public candidates for ecommerce marketplace, retail media, first-party shopper data, and attribution exposure in this pass.

The strongest node relation appears where a company controls discovery, checkout, transaction data, and ad inventory simultaneously; this creates a potential monetization flywheel through seller services, sponsored placement, and closed-loop measurement.

Potential follow-up names excluded due to the 5-candidate limit include EBAY, ETSY, KR, COST, BBY, UBER, PINS, TTD, ROKU, and ad-tech or measurement vendors tied to commerce media; these should be screened in a later adjacent-node or enabler pass.

Need a future evidence pass to normalize retail media exposure by revenue share, gross margin contribution, disclosed ad revenue, traffic quality, marketplace GMV, seller dependence, and whether ad spend is incremental or a reallocation from trade promotion budgets.
